title: Acts of the Fourth Council (Chalcedon)
english: I read the Acts of the fourth council, the council of Chalcedon, in several books. Fifteen sessions were held, at which Dioscorus and Eutyches were condemned and Nestorius excommunicated; Flavian was declared innocent after his death, together with Eusebius of Dorylaeum, Theodoret, and Ibas. Other matters were also taken up, and the spirit of piety was strengthened.
translator_notes: Greek locked from Bekker 1824; Freese 1920 used as PD English reference only.

Codex 17 of 279; Acts of the Fourth Council of Chalcedon (451), in several books; fifteen sessions. Dioscorus of Alexandria and Eutyches condemned; Nestorius excommunicated; Flavian of Constantinople vindicated posthumously with Eusebius of Dorylaeum, Theodoret of Cyrrhus, and Ibas of Edessa.
